name: Heart & Blood Vessels
summary: The heart pumps blood through arteries and veins, delivering oxygen and nutrients to every cell. Cardiovascular health depends on blood pressure, cholesterol balance, and vessel flexibility.

name: Brain & Nervous System
summary: The brain controls thought, memory, emotion, and movement. Neurons need steady glucose, healthy fats, and antioxidants to function and resist age-related decline.

name: Liver
summary: The liver filters toxins, stores energy, produces bile, and regulates fats and sugars in the blood. It is remarkably self-repairing when supported well.

name: Kidneys
summary: The paired kidneys filter waste from the blood, balance fluids and minerals, and help control blood pressure. They depend on good hydration and stable blood sugar and pressure.

name: Lungs & Airways
summary: The lungs exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide. Airway health is affected by inflammation, smoke exposure, and environmental pollutants.

name: Stomach & Gut
summary: The digestive tract breaks down food, absorbs nutrients, and hosts trillions of beneficial microbes that shape immunity and mood.

name: Pancreas & Blood Sugar
summary: The pancreas produces insulin and digestive enzymes. Stable blood sugar protects it and every organ it feeds.

name: Bones & Joints
summary: Bones and joints form the frame that lets the body move. Bone is living tissue that constantly remodels and needs calcium, vitamin D, and protein.

name: Skin
summary: The skin is the body's largest organ — a barrier against infection, UV radiation, and dehydration, and a mirror of internal nutrition.

name: Eyes
summary: The eyes convert light into nerve signals. The retina is rich in fats and vulnerable to oxidative and blue-light stress.

name: Immune System
summary: A network of cells and organs (including the gut) that defends against infections and abnormal cells. Nutrition status directly shapes immune competence.

name: Thyroid
summary: A butterfly-shaped gland in the neck that sets the pace of metabolism through iodine-dependent hormones.
